reference.code: exports.parseQuotedList=function(s){if(s==='')return[];const o=[];let i=0;while(true){if(s[i]!=='"')return null;i++;let v='',closed=false;while(i<s.length){if(s[i]==='"'){if(s[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i+=2}else{i++;closed=true;break}}else v+=s[i++]}if(!closed)return null;o.push(v);if(i===s.length)return o;if(s[i++]!==','||i===s.length)return null}}
